{{recipe}}

These '''raspberry shortbread bars''' are simply delicious! Stuffed full of fresh homemade raspberry jam and raspberry pieces, each bite fills you with a warm fuzzy feeling you can only get from such home-baked goodness. They are 100% vegan and gluten-free.

[http://www.foodista.com/recipe/6KLHVZJ5/raspberry-shortbread-bars-paleo-gluten-free-vegan Originally posted to Foodista] by user Justina Elumeze. Foodista recipes are released under a [http://www.foodista.com/static/legal CC-BY license].

==Ingredients==

=== Shortbread crust ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Almond Flour|almond flour]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Coconut oil|coconut oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]]

=== Jam filling ===
* 2 cups frozen [[Cookbook:Raspberry|raspberries]]
* 1 tbsp freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 2 tbsp maple syrup
* 1 tsp vanilla extract
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Chia Seed|chia seeds]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Tapioca Starch|tapioca starch]]

=== Topping ===
* ¼ recipe shortbread crust (see above)
* ¼ cup chopped [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]
==Preparation==

=== Shortbread crust ===
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 180°C.
#Combine all of the crust ingredients together until everything is evenly mixed. [[Cookbook:Dough|Dough]] should be crumbly but still form a dough when pressed together.
#Spread the dough onto a greased baking tray<sup>(''what size?'')</sup>. Press down slightly with a [[Cookbook:Spatula|spatula]] until the layer is evenly spread over the bottom of the tray.
#Prick the crust all over with a fork. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for approximately 15 minutes in the preheated oven.
#Remove from the oven and set aside.

=== Jam filling ===
#Combine the raspberries and syrup in a pot and allow to cook for approximately 5 minutes on a medium heat. Stir often to prevent the jam from burning.
#Add the remaining ingredients and continue to cook until the mixture is a thick consistency.
#Break down any raspberry pieces that may be too big before removing from the heat and allowing to cool down.

=== Assembly and baking ===
#Once cooled, spread the jam evenly all over the shortbread base.
#Prepare the quarter-recipe of crust to use as topping.
#Crumble topping and combine with almonds. Sprinkle topping over the jam spread. Place the tray back in the oven to bake for a further 15–20 minutes.
#Once golden brown, remove from the oven and allow to cool.
